AppLocale FAQ

What Type to Siri listing copy does AppLocale deliver?

Paste-ready zh-Hans for Connect listing fields — name, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot caption lines scoped to Type to Siri, text input to Siri, silent Siri requests, and 键入 Siri / 向 Siri 键入 / 无声 Siri vocabulary when your US listing markets those workflows.

How is Type to Siri listing copy different from Dictation?

Dictation covers speech-to-text into any text field via keyboard mic buttons. Type to Siri covers typing requests into the Siri interface under Settings → Accessibility → Siri → Type to Siri — a different input surface and buyer story.

How is this different from Voice Control, Live Speech, or Speak Screen?

Voice Control speaks commands to operate the UI hands-free. Live Speech types phrases to speak aloud in conversations. Speak Screen reads existing on-screen content aloud. Type to Siri sends typed text to Siri as a request — a different workflow on each surface.

How is this different from Spoken Content?

Spoken Content and Speak Screen cover read-aloud playback of on-screen text. Type to Siri sends typed input into Siri — input to the assistant, not audio output from the screen. See Speak Screen listing (zh-Hans) for read-aloud marketing.

Does AppLocale implement SiriKit or App Intents?

No. We deliver Connect listing metadata copy only. SiriKit integration, App Intents voice triggers, and Settings deep-link engineering are outside scope.
